title: 2026-11-25 — A delegate's answer-card confirm names the founder's answer only where its resolved line does

data.head: ## 2026-11-25 — A delegate's answer-card confirm names the founder's answer only where its resolved line does

body: At a wrap's Validate, `rec.py rows-land` writes each landed operation's sidecar entry Why from the proposer's `because:` and from its disposition line's `· resolved: …` text. So a row resolved through an answer card that a delegate confirmed — the founder away — carries only the delegate's confirm into its sidecar, and the founder's own answer that the card covers is named nowhere in the entry.

Where a directive asks each entry to give his label and its source, write them into every resolved line after the authority's first `: ` (for example `«Confirm all 7 (Recommended)», confirming the operation inside the founder's own F1 A «…» (inputs#I{n})`). Then read every entry whole in the `rows-land` dry run before the landing.

The session added canvas lint: the lint verb now reads truncated once per label a canvas widget paints whose ink box is not inside its region, in paint order, chained after the DOM truncated reading and before contrast.
The region is the element's content box cut by each pushed clip, layer or mask path's bounding box and by the element's clip region; a label's ink box is read from its glyph outline bounds through skrifa.
A canvas finding carries only numbers (the label's ink box and its visible part) under the closed key set; no label text or glyph id crosses, and the six-defect set and the answer's written form are unchanged.
Circle Drawer's labels now reach the lint as truncated boxes with no label text, and Circle Drawer reads no canvas finding at boot, after a click and at 12 and 100 circles, in both layout modes.
The new stand target stand_canvas_lint joins the stand-repeat rounds by the existing glob; the named-target count stays seventeen and CI read green 17/17.
Four lint-like checks were left out and unowned: labels overlapping one another, a label's contrast against the fill under it, a command wholly outside its region, and a shape with no area.

body_fields.fact: A canvas label's region is the widget's content box cut by the bounding box of each pushed clip, layer or mask path, mapped through its transform, and by the element's clip region; its ink box is the union of its glyphs' outline bounds; a label reads truncated when its ink box is not inside that region (PROVISIONAL, a delegate's answer).
escher-driver takes skrifa, the workspace's version already in the graph, to read a glyph's outline bounds for the canvas lint (PROVISIONAL, a delegate's answer).

The lint reads no other check inside a canvas: labels overlapping one another, a label's contrast against the fill under it, a command wholly outside its region and a shape with no area are not read (an absence, PROVISIONAL).
A canvas label's region is never the shape or the virtual node under it, only the content box and the clips; that reading is deferred to Circle Drawer's circles as virtual nodes (PROVISIONAL).
A glyph run whose font skrifa cannot read adds no canvas label and no finding, and never panics.

body: The lint defects contract's truncated item: truncated is now also read for a canvas label whose ink box is not inside its region, once per label, with the ink box and the visible box as its numbers.
The lint findings order contract: a canvas element's truncated findings come once per label in paint order, after the DOM truncated reading and before contrast.
The lint defect set and its six-word pin stay unchanged; a row holding the six defects or their order is read, not moved.
The escher-session command line lint item and the driver verb table: the lint verb's help text now names the canvas label and its ink box.

Rules that the lint and session write nothing of the screen and that answers hold fixed words and numbers only: a canvas finding crosses as four numbers per box, no label text or glyph id, asserted by the new target.
One integration test target per file or behaviour: a new stand target joins the blitz-tests targets, picked up by the existing glob.
Shared stand tables and session checks in one module, and shared test modules being no target: Circle Drawer's helpers moved there from the canvas commands target, bodies unchanged.

Unit tests in an inline module in their source file: the canvas label reader's unit tests sit in a child test module in a separate file, a convention exception unless a split-module row already allows it.
Stand checks and layout assertions in both layout modes: each new stand test runs in both modes.
Stand checks on the bundled real font, never skipping: the canvas ink box is measured from DejaVu Sans glyph outlines at 20 px.
Expected value pinned as a literal and table-driven tests counting their rows: the planted page's findings table holds five rows, and Circle Drawer's glyph runs are pinned at 0, 1, 12 and 100.
Tests controlled red-before-green: six controls held for the new target, the clipped-box case moved to x 90 so its control reads red.
Capability claims naming their checks and the capability statement held to the schema: the visual lint section gains the new witness.
Every requirement witnessed inside stand-repeat and its three rounds: the new target runs inside stand-repeat by the glob, its named-target count of seventeen unchanged.
Canvas shots compared across hosts by digest: the Circle Drawer canvas digest watch read its third green run on Windows and macOS and met its retire condition.
The canvas commands table across hosts: the canvas commands target now reads its canvas id and helpers from the shared module, its assertions unchanged.
Dependency audit of advisories and licenses: the driver takes skrifa, already in the graph, one lock edge, audit green.
Doc leg gating public doc comment edits: the truncated defect, its reason text, Session::lint and the crate doc's lint paragraph changed, the doc leg green.
Per-crate coverage floors: the driver crate gains a new private module with its unit tests.
Handler coverage leaving canvas handlers uncounted: unchanged, but a row describing what the lint or coverage reads of a canvas may need to sit beside the canvas lint.

body_fields.fact: The canvas lint is proven on a planted page of numbered label cases, each past an edge, a clip, the ascent, inside, inside a clipped box or after a pop, and on Circle Drawer reading no canvas finding at boot, after a click and at 12 and 100 circles, in both layout modes (PROVISIONAL, delegate's answer).

body: WPT conformance, its runner, statuses, expectations and pinned commit.
The cold-agent pipe and the agent-run contract, their events, verbs, exit codes and verdicts.
The session wire, socket, state directory, recording and check replay: no IPC method, endpoint, field or bound moved.
Driver refusal causes, session errors and exit codes of escher-session: none added or reordered.
The MCP protocol revision, protocol errors and the refused and screenshot tool result forms.
The virtual clock, advance, settle and timer driving, and the hand-written stand-ins with no mocking library.
CI job structure, the leg script, triggers, caches, pinned actions and package installs: the new target joins existing legs by glob.
Snapshot text budget, screenshot and shot PNG rows, and committed recorded checks.
Mutation testing, complexity ceilings and oversize-file rows.
